allOf.description: Inherits shared step-base properties ($schema, id, owner, created_at, canonical_refs_used).

missing_elements.description: Elements missing from the spec suite that affect completeness.

element_id.description: Unique kebab-case identifier for this missing element.

category.description: The dimension of completeness affected: traceability, completeness, quality, or ambiguity.

description.description: Description of what is missing and why it matters.

priority.description: Priority level for addressing this gap.

impact_on_completeness.description: Fractional impact on overall completeness score (0 = none, 1 = maximum).

specification_source.description: Spec files where this element should have been defined.

items.description: A spec file name where this element should have been defined.

risk_category_ref.description: Canonical reference for the risk category of this gap.

completeness_dimension_ref.description: Canonical reference for the completeness dimension in the registry.

tag_ref.description: Canonical reference for the tag associated with this element.

items.description: A single missing element with category, priority, impact, and source specification.

completeness_rating.description: Overall completeness rating of the spec suite.

current.description: Current completeness score on a 0-10 scale.

confidence_level.description: Confidence in the accuracy of the current rating (0 = no confidence, 1 = certain).
